- **Waiting:** Codex on GitHub Actions has no plan, but it has a `Waiting:` line, so it can't be queued until a person removes it.
- **Plan up to date:** every other ticket.

Nothing in this checkout changed, so there was nothing to commit. The queue command commits to the `agent-data` branch by itself.
